scope: Local server, read-only connectors, Claude/ChatGPT, dashboard, Ask, ringing (screens, ntfy, Twilio), the Electron desktop app, and the home-screen phone app plus a sideloaded Android APK.

owner_decision.approval: Rename to OXBOT, remove AI-slop design, build a clean dashboard, connect Strava, Gmail, Slack, Sheets, Claude, ChatGPT, calendars, WHOOP, Google Health, Outlook and other CEO tools, and plan the phone app that rings like an alarm.

notes: Connectors read by default. Since November 1, 2026 OXBOT may act (email, Slack, texts, calls, GitHub, Linear, Composio tools, food) only after the owner approves each exact action. Moving money, money movement, screen capture beyond the November 5 computer-use rules (docs/19-computer-use.md), speech models other than local Kokoro (Nov 5), cloud deployment, Tailscale and the native iPhone build stay locked until the owner decides. The stateless sign-in service (apps/broker) is authorized; deploying it is the owner's step. Microphone through the browser's speech recognition is authorized (Oct 31) for push-to-talk and the opt-in wake word. Desktop (Electron, tray) and phone (home-screen web app + Android APK, Wi-Fi only) authorized Oct 31; unsigned personal builds, never published.

microphone_decision.approval: Browser speech recognition (Google in Chrome, Apple in Safari) for push-to-talk and an opt-in wake word, off by default, only while the tab is visible. Nothing recorded or stored.

app_decision.approval: Electron desktop app that keeps running in the tray (start at login off); home-screen web app plus a sideloaded Android debug APK; phone reaches the Mac over Wi-Fi only (plain http). Native iPhone app not chosen.

connectors_decision.approval: Many more read-only connectors (Notion, Todoist, Trello, Asana, Jira, GitLab, Discord, Telegram, Teams, Zoom, Dropbox, Box, OneDrive, Google Drive, Airtable, Salesforce, QuickBooks, Spotify, Garmin, Fitbit, Apple Health export, RSS, weather and similar). Read-only scopes only, secrets in ~/.oxbot or .env, mocked tests, shown as Not connected.

ai_decision.free_plan: OpenRouter free models on the owner's own free account, OAuth PKCE to localhost, default nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free
ai_decision.paid: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Mistral, DeepSeek, Groq, Cerebras, Together, Perplexity, Cohere, Kimi, Qwen, Ollama, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, each with the owner's own key
ai_decision.tested: mocked responses only, except the public OpenRouter model list

ring_takeover: desktop app fills the whole screen above every app and Space while ringing; the iPhone home-screen app cannot (needs a phone call or a native app)

composio_decision.approval: Composio connector for hundreds more apps, like OpenMausBot and Grok Bot. OXBOT stores only the Composio API key, lists connected accounts and reads through Composio's proxy with GET only; never runs Composio tools or creates connections. Composio holds the app sign-ins in its cloud and its managed sign-ins may carry more than read scopes.

actions_decision.invariant: Nothing is sent, posted, called, bought or changed without the owner explicitly approving that exact action.
actions_decision.still_needs_owner: Anything deployed to the cloud, including a public address for inbound calls (tunnel or relay).

voice_tunnel_decision.question: Should the app session set up the Cloudflare tunnel for calling OXBOT from your phone?
voice_tunnel_decision.approval: Cloudflare Tunnel on the owner's own Cloudflare account pointed at localhost:8787, reaching only /api/voice/* (tunnel ingress rule plus the server's proxy wall), with Twilio signature, owner's caller ID and keypad PIN.
voice_tunnel_decision.owner_steps: Cloudflare sign-in, hostname, PIN, Twilio webhook. Agents never type those credentials, buy a domain or change other account settings.

computer_use_decision.question: Should OXBOT be allowed Screen Recording and Accessibility so helpers can act in other apps?
computer_use_decision.then: just do everything in sequential order
computer_use_decision.recorded: Asked 'Should I update AGENTS.md and PROJECT_STATE.json, if you allow it?', the owner answered 'Yes, allow it'.
computer_use_decision.approval: Desktop app only, after the owner switches each permission on himself. Screen Recording: one picture when asked, password managers excluded, sent to the chosen AI, noted in Activity, never stored. Accessibility: fixed-verb oxbot-hands helper in apps on the owner's allow list (first: Canva and Notes may act, Chrome may look), one helper at a time, Esc or mouse takeover stops it; password managers, Keychain Access, System Settings, Terminal and banking/payment apps never. Approval cards unchanged for send/post/share/buy/delete/invite/sign in. A separate OXBOT Chrome profile for helpers, read-only.

clap_wake_decision.approval: Double clap or snap to start Talk: off by default, switched on in Settings, Voice; only while the tab is visible; the browser measures microphone loudness above speech pitch locally; no sound or words recorded, kept or sent. clap_wake_decision.still_not_authorized: Recording or sending microphone audio beyond the browser's own speech recognition; listening while the tab is hidden; clap detection in the desktop app's window.

files_plans_mcp_schedule_decision.question: Record the new file, plan-app, MCP, screen-share and schedule permissions in AGENTS.md?
files_plans_mcp_schedule_decision.approval: Search file names in Downloads, Desktop, Documents and Pictures and open one picture or text file (up to 5 MB) when the owner asks about a file; no hidden, linked-out or password-like files; nothing written. Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini plans through Claude Code (tools off), Codex (read-only sandbox) and Gemini CLI (plan mode) as fixed programs with fixed arguments, prompt on stdin, no shell; Kimi and GLM plans by plan key; usage counted in ~/.oxbot. MCP servers by https or localhost address over Streamable HTTP: read-only tools run, all others need an approval card; OXBOT never starts a server program. Screen sharing through the browser's own picker, one frame per question while shared, nothing stored. Scheduled tasks run at their time and show the answer; they never approve anything.
files_plans_mcp_schedule_decision.still_not_authorized: Reading files outside the four folders; writing, moving or deleting files; starting MCP server programs; screen capture beyond the November 5 and 6 rules.
files_plans_mcp_schedule_decision.tested: temp folders, a fake MCP server, fake plan apps and mocked hubs (apps/server/test/nov6.test.ts); 125 more read-only connectors against mocked responses (test/more-fixtures.ts)
